competitors.name: Jan Deux
competitors.why_competitor: New Lagos luxury house with oud, vanilla and gourmand scents priced in naira, aimed at the same female and gifting buyer.

socials.source: Instagram profile meta description, 2026-11-25 (shown as 19K; 175 posts)

competitors.current_offer: None visible; no Black Friday banner. Half the range sold out (Eclipse, Rivage, 3x10ml set).
strengths: 19K Instagram followers about 14 months after launch
Gifting add-ons: wrapping, note scroll, vanity bag, discovery box
Physical shop at WestBrook Mall, Lekki
Scent territory overlaps Beguile bestsellers
weaknesses: N1,800-2,200 per ml, more than double Beguile
No shipping or returns policy page
Cheapest trial is a N100,000 4x10ml set

competitors.name: Perfumeology
competitors.why_competitor: Nigerian-made 100ml perfumes at N80,000 sold direct, with a seduction theme that overlaps Beguile's naming and price.

socials.source: No social accounts linked from the site; official handle not found, 2026-11-25

competitors.current_offer: Seductive Flame 100ml N120,000 (was N150,000, -20%); Royal Seduction N260,000 (was N350,000, -26%, sold out); free atomizer banner; Seduction Circle membership N5,000/month for 15% off.
strengths: Lowest per-ml price among original-fragrance brands (N800/ml)
Paid membership drives repeat purchase
Higher-priced tiers stretch the ladder to N260,000
weaknesses: Dated site with a broken testimonial block and misspelled contact email

competitors.name: Yerwa Secrets
competitors.why_competitor: Nigerian artisan house with oud, vanilla and rose scents plus body oils and a strong heritage story, drawing the same niche-curious buyer at a higher price.

socials.source: Handle from BellaNaija photo credit (2026-08-27); not linked from site; follower count not found, 2026-11-25

strengths: Distinctive Borno heritage story and khumra format
Press beyond Nigeria (BellaNaija; Fragrantica interview reported)
Creator collaborations as limited drops
Oils and incense widen the basket
DHL delivery to all states in 3-7 working days
weaknesses: About twice Beguile's price per ml
Discovery sets cost N40,000-80,000 for 2ml vials

competitors.name: Toke Makinwa Beauty
competitors.why_competitor: Celebrity-founded Nigerian fragrance line pitched at the same aspirational woman, with national reach through Seinde Signature stores.

hero_product.name: Intense (Extrait de Parfum; out of stock)
hero_product.source: Price: https://tokemakinwabeauty.com.ng/shop/ ; size not stated on listing, 100ml per site stock notice and third-party review https://www.pulse.ng/story/toke-makinwa-perfume-review-2025092208573045473

socials.source: Linked from tokemakinwabeauty.com; follower count not found, 2026-11-25

competitors.current_offer: None visible. Dive, Intense, Faya and Oud Rush full bottles out of stock on the Nigerian site; banner sends buyers to Seinde Signature for Intense 100ml.
strengths: Founder's personal fame and audience
Stocked in Seinde Signature stores nationwide
Strong third-party longevity review
Premium pricing accepted
weaknesses: Four of five full bottles out of stock in Nigeria
About double Beguile's price per ml
Bottle sizes missing from listings; no reviews or quiz

competitors.name: Majestic Roobee
competitors.why_competitor: Female-focused indigenous brand with the largest Nigerian Instagram following in this set and a much lower entry price. Part of the catalogue is designer-inspired oils.
competitors.current_offer: "Enjoy All Promos" sign-up banner; no specific discount stated.
strengths: 50.7K Instagram followers
Testimonial and influencer video at scale
Branches in several cities and an Abuja perfume studio
Low ticket: N25,000-30,000 for 30ml
Broad basket including feminine care and body mists

competitors.name: Maison Yusif
competitors.why_competitor: Most followed West African niche house; ships worldwide and is the regional benchmark for a Nigerian niche buyer. Weakest fit of the six: no naira pricing or Nigerian stockist found.

hero_product.name: Scent of A Queen (Extrait de Parfum; pre-order)
hero_product.source: https://maisonyusif.com/shop/women/scent-of-a-queen/ (page shows $65-$135 across 30/50/100ml; 100ml taken as top of range)

socials.source: Instagram profile meta description, 2026-11-25 (shown as 108K; 2,293 posts)
Linked from maisonyusif.com; follower count not found

competitors.current_offer: $10 off eligible pre-order sizes; complimentary shipping banner with no stated threshold. Several bestsellers pre-order only until December 2026.
strengths: 108K Instagram followers
Award credentials
Full size ladder from 30ml
Sample-first funnel
weaknesses: No naira pricing or Nigerian stockist found
7-20 business days cross-border with customs risk
Returns only for unopened items within 48 hours
